findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "nukez_store" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: nukez_quote, nukez_store, nukez_recompute_verify, nukez_remember, nukez_recall · Private data: nukez_quote, nukez_pay, nukez_setup, nukez_create_file, nukez_store, nukez_confirm, nukez_upload_chunk, nukez_retrieve, nukez_verify, nukez_recompute_verify, nukez_status, nukez_delete, nukez_remember, nukez_recall · Public sink: nukez_quote, nukez_create_file, nukez_store, nukez_confirm, nukez_upload_chunk, nukez_recompute_verify, nukez_remember · Destructive: nukez_pay, nukez_setup, nukez_create_file, nukez_store, nukez_upload_chunk, nukez_verify, nukez_delete.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: nukez_quote, nukez_store, nukez_recompute_verify, nukez_remember, nukez_recall · Private data: nukez_quote, nukez_pay, nukez_setup, nukez_create_file, nukez_store, nukez_confirm, nukez_upload_chunk, nukez_retrieve, nukez_verify, nukez_recompute_verify, nukez_status, nukez_delete, nukez_remember, nukez_recall · Public sink: nukez_quote, nukez_create_file, nukez_store, nukez_confirm, nukez_upload_chunk, nukez_recompute_verify, nukez_remember · Destructive: nukez_pay, nukez_setup, nukez_create_file, nukez_store, nukez_upload_chunk, nukez_verify, nukez_delete

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
